name: Zunami Protocol
rootCause: Zunami Protocol has reported a hack in which the collateral for zunUSD and zunETH was stolen, resulting in a loss of approximately $500,000. The attacker has transferred the stolen funds to Tornado Cash.

descriptions.text: $500k vanished from Zunami Protocol in a mid-May admin key exploit. Months of stagnant development & perfect timing may have paved the way. Team offered weak excuses, dismissed concerns, left users empty-handed. When emergency keys open doors, who's in control?

Zunami Protocol has reported a hack in which the collateral for zunUSD and zunETH was stolen, resulting in a loss of approximately $500,000. The attacker has transferred the stolen funds to Tornado Cash.

On May 14, 2025, Zunami Protocol on Ethereum lost $500,000 when privileged admin access was used to drain all stablecoin collateral. The exploit involved rapid admin role grants followed by immediate emergency withdrawals. Multiple independent forensic sources traced the funds through Tornado Cash and centralized exchanges, with protocol and founder records indicating unresolved insider or key compromise risk. No recovery or confirmed compensation has been documented.
